answer: Entry works like a toll bridge whose price rises with traffic: each epoch the first new key posts a 10 POA bond, and every further key that epoch pays 1.5x the one before, so a farm minting 20 keys at once locks over 66,000 POA. Bonds stay shut like a pearl in an oyster for 30 epochs and burn if graders find two keys' answers grown in the same grove of near-duplicate text. Spreading keys across epochs keeps fees low but makes a farm wait months to scale, while an honest newcomer pays just 10 POA.
